recognize_zh: 低倍下一個萎縮的生發中心呈粉紅、玻璃樣外觀，淋巴球稀少，內含核大且淡染的濾泡樹突細胞與穿入的小血管，外圍被一圈圈同心排列的小淋巴球（洋蔥皮狀 mantle zone）包住；這是透明血管型單中心性 Castleman 病的典型濾泡。
features: Regressed, lymphocyte-depleted germinal center with eosinophilic hyaline-appearing stroma
Germinal center composed of follicular dendritic cells with enlarged pale vesicular and irregular nuclei plus endothelial cells
Small vessel penetrating into the germinal center
Expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers
Interfollicular region at left with increased vessels and spindle stromal cells
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a follicle with a small, regressed germinal center that is depleted of lymphocytes and composed of eosinophilic stroma, endothelial cells and follicular dendritic cells with enlarged, vesicular, irregular nuclei. A small vessel penetrates the germinal center. The surrounding mantle zone is expanded, with small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric rings, and the interfollicular area is vascular. Findings are consistent with unicentric Castleman disease, hyaline-vascular type.

ddx.vs: HIV-associated follicle lysis and involution can mimic regressed germinal centers but usually lacks prominent onion-skin mantles and occurs with clinical HIV infection.
AITL shows regressed follicles with expanded FDC meshworks but has an atypical clear-cell T-cell infiltrate with PD1/CXCL13 expression and arborizing high endothelial venules.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma with mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mantle cells are cyclin D1+/CD5+ and slightly irregular, while the germinal centers are usually reactive rather than hyalinized.
